Centrally located in the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex, Irving has a population of 256,000+ residents and is one of the most culturally diverse cities in the state and nation. The City of Irving is home to 9 Fortune 500 corporate headquarters, over 8,500 businesses, four 18-hole championship golf courses and the DFW International Airport.

ICTN videos and programs can also be seen on Spectrum Channel 16 and Frontier Channel 30. And look for updates on events and initiatives across the major social media platforms @TheCityOfIrving.
